capabilities: Render timesheet report code blocks inside daily notes
Group and round logged time by task number pattern
Warn about overlapping time entries in a note
Query reports over date ranges of daily notes
Configure multiple sheet types with patterns and templates
disambiguation: Not a time tracker that records your time; it sums time intervals you have already written into daily notes.
extras: Ships with no sheet types by default; a sample vault is referenced for more examples, and development was assisted by the obsidian-plugin-skill by gapmiss.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sum the time already logged per task across daily notes into a report for standups or worklogs.
summary: Timesheet generator that aggregates timed task entries in daily notes into grouped reports for JIRA-style issue keys.
